FLASHCARD · HOME AND DAILY LIFE · AGES 3–5 YEARS

Bedroom Words Flashcard for Preschoolers

Ages 3+Rooms of the home

The bedroom card names the room&rsquo;s own furniture: the bed, the pillow, the blanket, the wardrobe and the bedside table — everything a good night needs, in five words.

← Furniture WordsPrevious cardBedroom Objects →Next card

Say it together

“Bedroom words! The bed holds you, the pillow holds your head, the blanket holds the warm in. The wardrobe keeps your clothes — some families say closet — and the bedside table keeps your water and your book.”

Say it naturally, then wait. Whatever comes back — the word, the sound, a point, a giggle — is the right answer.

Try this

Tonight, name all five as they happen: pillow fluffed, blanket up, book on the bedside table, light off. Bedtime runs smoother when every step has a name.

Quick parent note

Wardrobe and closet are the same friend wearing different name tags — pick whichever your family says, or teach both and let your child enjoy knowing a second word nobody asked for.
